blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Biotechnology) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define biotechnology. What is its main focus?
(Biotechnology ki definition likhein. Is ki asal tawajjo kis par hai?)
blocks.explanation: Biotechnology organisms, biological processes ya systems ka istemal hai taa ke aise products banein jo insani zindagi aur mahol behtar karein. Is ki asal tawajjo medicine, zaraat (agriculture) aur industry ke mushkil masail hal karna hai.

book_ref.quote: Its main focus is to solve complex challenges in medicine, agriculture, and industry.

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between traditional and modern biotechnology.
(Riwayati (traditional) aur jadeed (modern) biotechnology mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Riwayati biotechnology purani fermentation hai; jadeed DNA techniques par mabni hai.

book_ref.quote: Modern biotechnology emerged in the 20th century, after the discovery of the structure of DNA

rows: Hazaron saal se istemal
20vi sadi mein saamne aayi
Fermentation (khameer) ki shakal mein
DNA ki structure aur advanced molecular techniques ki daryaft ke baad
Bread, cheese aur beer jaise khane banati hai
Is ka asal engine genetic engineering hai

blocks.prompt:
3 Define genetic engineering. What does it involve?
(Genetic engineering ki definition likhein. Is mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Genetic engineering kisi organism ke DNA mein tabdeeli hai taa ke us ke traits ya salahiyatein badlein. Is mein genes daalna, nikaalna ya badalna, aur kabhi mukhtalif species ke darmiyan genes muntaqil karna shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: It involves inserting, deleting, or modifying genes

blocks.prompt:
4 Name the two basic technologies of genetic engineering and state what each does.
(Genetic engineering ki do buniyadi technologies ke naam likhein aur batayein ke har aik kya karti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Recombinant DNA technology: aik organism ke DNA ka tukra kaat kar doosre ke DNA mein jodna.
2. Polymerase chain reaction (PCR): DNA ke chhote tukre ko tezi se bari miqdar mein barhana.

book_ref.quote: In genetic engineering, scientists rely on two basic technologies:

blocks.prompt:
5 What is meant by recombinant DNA technology?
(Recombinant DNA technology se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh mukhtalif zarai ke DNA molecules ko kaat kar, jod kar aik hybrid molecule banana hai. Is mein recombinant DNA (rDNA) ko host (maslan bacteria) mein dalna bhi shamil hai taa ke naye genetic combinations ya makhsoos proteins banein.

book_ref.quote: It also involves the introduction of recombinant DNA (rDNA) into a host

blocks.text: 20.2.1 Tools used in Recombinant DNA Technology

blocks.prompt:
6 What is a restriction site? How does a restriction endonuclease act on it?
(Restriction site kya hai? Restriction endonuclease us par kaise amal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Restriction site (recognition region) DNA ki woh makhsoos nucleotide sequence hai jise aik khaas restriction endonuclease pehchanta hai. Enzyme us sequence par DNA se judta aur site ke andar aik khaas jagah se kaat'ta hai.

book_ref.quote: Each kind recognizes a specific nucleotide sequence in a DNA.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is meant by the palindromic sequence of a restriction site?
(Restriction site ki palindromic sequence se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Restriction sites ki palindromic sequences chaar se aath nucleotides ki hoti hain: aik sire ke nucleotides doosre sire ke complementary hote hain, is liye dono strands ki sequence aik jaisi magar mukhalif simton mein chalti hai.

book_ref.quote: This means the nucleotides at one end of the restriction site are complementary to those at the other end.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Palindrome ka matlab hai aage se aur peeche se aik jaisa parhna. DNA mein aik strand ko aik simt se aur doosre strand ko ulti simt se parhein to sequence aik jaisi milti hai.

blocks.prompt:
8 What are sticky ends? How are they formed?
(Sticky ends kya hain? Yeh kaise bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Restriction endonuclease restriction site par dono strands ko kaat'ta hai. Dono tukron ke chand nucleotides lambe single-stranded sire bante hain jo aapas mein complementary hain; yahi sticky ends hain.

book_ref.quote: Restriction endonuclease binds to and cleaves both strands.

blocks.prompt:
9 Name any four vectors used in recombinant DNA technology other than bacterial plasmids.
(Bacterial plasmids ke ilawa recombinant DNA technology ke koi chaar vectors ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Bacteriophages (maslan phage lambda, bacteriophage P1)
2. Cosmids
3. Bacterial artificial chromosomes (BACs)
4. Yeast artificial chromosomes (YACs)
(P1 artificial chromosomes aur human cold virus jaise animal viruses bhi)

book_ref.quote: The plasmids of bacteria are the most commonly used.

blocks.prompt:
10 What are cosmids and P1 artificial chromosomes?
(Cosmids aur P1 artificial chromosomes kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cosmids woh plasmids hain jin mein bacteriophage DNA ka chhota hissa, cos sequence, hota hai. P1 artificial chromosomes aise vectors hain jin mein P1 vectors aur bacterial artificial chromosomes dono ki khususiyaat hain.

book_ref.quote: P1 artificial chromosomes (have features of both P1 vectors and Bacterial Artificial Chromosomes)

blocks.prompt:
11 What is an expression system? Why are bacteria used as one?
(Expression system kya hai? Bacteria ko expression system kyun banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Expression system woh munasib organism hai jo rDNA ka host bane aur gene of interest ko express kare. Is ka intikhab vector ki qisam par munhasir hai. Bacteria ki short generation time aur saada genetic system ki wajah se unhein istemal kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Expression system means a suitable organism that can act as host for rDNA

blocks.prompt:
12 How is a recombinant vector cloned?
(Recombinant vector ki cloning kaise hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Recombinant DNA (vector) aur expression system (aam taur par bacteria) aik hi medium mein rakhe jaate hain. Bacterial cells recombinant DNA le kar barhte hain aur aise clones bante hain jin mein gene of interest ki aik jaisi copies hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: The bacterial cells take up recombinant DNA.

blocks.prompt:
13 How does antibiotic resistance help in selecting bacteria that took up the vector?
(Antibiotic resistance vector lene wale bacteria chunne mein kaise madad deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Plasmid mein antibiotic resistance gene hota hai. Bacteria us antibiotic (maslan ampicillin) wale medium par ugaye jaate hain; sirf woh cells zinda reh kar barhte hain jinhon ne plasmid liya.

book_ref.quote: The plasmid contains an antibiotic resistance gene.

blocks.prompt:
14 Differentiate between blue and white colonies in blue-white screening.
(Blue-white screening mein neeli aur safaid colonies mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Neeli colonies mein saada plasmid; safaid colonies mein recombinant plasmid.

book_ref.quote: If the plasmid is not recombinant, the lacZ' gene remains functional

rows: Plasmid recombinant nahi
Gene of interest kamyabi se dakhil
lacZ' gene kaam karta rehta hai
Dakhil gene lacZ' gene ko tor deta hai
Is ka enzyme sugar ko neela kar deta hai
Enzyme nahi, sugar neela nahi hota
Radd kar di jati hain
Matloob recombinant clones

blocks.prompt:
15 How is the presence of the gene of interest confirmed by DNA hybridization?
(DNA hybridization se gene of interest ki mojoodgi kaise yaqeeni banayi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik radioactive probe, yani gene of interest ka complementary DNA strand, istemal hota hai. Yeh sirf us gene wali colonies se chipakta hai aur autoradiography (photographic film) in colonies ko master plate par dhoondti hai.

book_ref.quote: The probe sticks (hybridizes) only to the colonies containing the gene of interest.

blocks.prompt:
16 What is PCR? Who developed it?
(PCR kya hai? Ise kis ne banaya?)
blocks.explanation: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) aisi technique hai jis mein DNA polymerase DNA ke tukre ko baar baar copy kar ke gene of interest ki kai aik jaisi copies banata hai. Kary Mullis ne ise 1983 mein banaya aur 1993 mein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize jeeta.

book_ref.quote: In this technique, multiple identical copies of the gene of interest are made.

blocks.prompt:
17 What happens during denaturation in PCR?
(PCR mein denaturation ke dauran kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primer (20 se 30 nucleotides) ki zyada miqdar DNA tukre se milayi jati hai aur mixture taqreeban 98°C tak garam hota hai. Double-stranded DNA single strands mein toot jata hai aur har strand in vitro DNA synthesis ka template banta hai.

book_ref.quote: At this temperature, the double-stranded DNA breaks into single strands.

blocks.prompt:
18 Differentiate between denaturation and annealing in PCR.
(PCR mein denaturation aur annealing mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Denaturation garmi se strands alag karti hai; annealing thanda kar ke primers jodti hai.

book_ref.quote: As it cools, the forward and the backward primers anneal or hybridize to the single-stranded DNA

rows: PCR ka pehla qadam
PCR ka doosra qadam
Mixture taqreeban 98°C tak garam
Solution taqreeban 60°C tak thanda
Double-stranded DNA single strands mein toot'ta hai
Forward aur backward primers complementary hisson se jurte hain
Single strands template bante hain
Baqi tukra single-stranded rehta hai

blocks.prompt:
19 What happens during extension of primer in PCR?
(PCR mein primer ki extension ke dauran kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Garmi bardasht karne wala Taq polymerase aur chaaron qisam ke nucleotides dale jaate hain. Taq polymerase primer ke 3' sire par naye nucleotides jod kar baqi tukre ki complementary copy banata hai; dono strands replicate hote hain aur do copies banti hain.

book_ref.quote: A very heat-stable DNA polymerase, called Taq polymerase is added.

blocks.prompt:
20 Why is Taq polymerase used in PCR? What is its source?
(PCR mein Taq polymerase kyun istemal hota hai? Yeh kahan se milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taq polymerase garmi bardasht karne wala enzyme hai jo ubalne ke qareeb temperature par bhi mustahkam aur fa'al rehta hai; garmi ise nuqsan nahi deti aur har cycle mein naya polymerase nahi dalna parta. Yeh garam chashmon ke bacterium Thermus aquaticus se nikala jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This enzyme is stable and active at near-boiling temperatures.

blocks.prompt:
21 How fast does PCR increase the number of DNA molecules?
(PCR DNA molecules ki tadaad kitni tezi se barhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har cycle aik ya do minute leta hai aur DNA molecules dugne karta hai (2 → 4 → 8 …). 20 cycles ke baad aik DNA tukre se das lakh se zyada copies banti hain.

book_ref.quote: Each cycle is completed in one or two minutes and it doubles the number of DNA molecules.

blocks.prompt:
22 What is a genomic library? Give its use.
(Genomic library kya hai? Is ka istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Genomic library aik organism ke kul DNA ka majmua hai; ise banane mein PCR bhi istemal hota hai. Genomic libraries aam taur par DNA sequencing ke liye istemal hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: It is the collection of the total DNA from a single organism.

blocks.prompt:
23 Give the use of PCR in medical diagnosis.
(Tibbi tashkhees (medical diagnosis) mein PCR ka istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Infectious agents (bimari phailane walon) ke genotypes ki pehchan.
2. Kuch genetic bimariyon aur cancers ki zimmedar genetic mutations ki pehchan.
3. Chand jhare hue cells ka DNA barha kar bohat ibtidai embryos mein genetic naqais dhoondna.

book_ref.quote: It is an efficient diagnostic technique used for detecting genotypes of infectious agents.

blocks.prompt:
24 How is PCR useful in criminal investigations and in the study of extinct species?
(Jurm ki tehqeeq aur khatam shuda species ke mutale mein PCR kaise mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Jurm ki tehqeeq: sookhe khoon ke chhote namoone ya aik baal ki jar ke cells se DNA fingerprints tayyar hote hain.
Khatam shuda species: PCR un ka DNA jaanch sakta hai jab tak us ki bohat thodi miqdar bhi saalim ho.

book_ref.quote: are prepared from the cells in a tiny sample of dried blood

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate between a GMO and a transgenic organism.
(GMO aur transgenic organism mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Har transgenic organism GMO hai, magar transgenic mein kisi ghair-mutaliq species ka DNA hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A Genetically Modified Organism is a plant, animal or microbe in which the genome has been changed.

rows: Paudha, janwar ya microbe jis ka genome badla gaya ho
GMOs ka aik makhsoos hissa
Tabdeeli kisi bhi qisam ki ho sakti hai
Kisi doosri, ghair-mutaliq species ka DNA mila ho

blocks.prompt:
26 How is a gene transferred to produce a whole multicellular GMO?
(Poora multicellular GMO banane ke liye gene kaise muntaqil kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene ko cell tabah kiye baghair cell membrane ya cell wall ke raaste target cell mein dala jata hai. Poore multicellular GMO ke liye gene gamete ya gamete banane wale tissue mein dala jata hai aur aise gametes mila kar GMO banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Such gametes are then fused to produce GMOs.

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between electroporation and microinjection.
(Electroporation aur microinjection mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Electroporation aarzi suraakh banata hai; microinjection sui se gene dalta hai.

book_ref.quote: In electroporation, pores are created in the cell wall or cell membrane of target cell.

rows: Cell wall ya cell membrane mein suraakh banaye jaate hain
Bareek sui (injection) istemal hoti hai
Gene suraakhon se andar jata hai
Gene seedha nucleus mein dala jata hai
Bijli ka current khatam hote hi suraakh band
Gene khud nucleus ke andar rakha jata hai

blocks.prompt:
28 What is biolistic transformation?
(Biolistic transformation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh gene transfer ka tareeqa hai jis mein gene of interest heavy metal (aam taur par gold ya tungsten) ke khurdbeeni zarron par chadhaya jata hai aur gene gun ki mechanical quwwat se target cell mein maara jata hai.

book_ref.quote: which the gene gun shoots into the cell

blocks.prompt:
29 Describe the protoplast-mediated technique of gene transfer.
(Gene transfer ki protoplast mediated technique bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Target cell ki cell wall hata kar protoplast banaya jata hai; is ki cell membrane saalim rehti hai. Protoplast ko gene of interest wale medium mein milaya jata hai aur DNA membrane ke raaste andar jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This protoplast is mixed with the medium containing the gene of interest.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein likha hai ke cell membrane bhi hatayi jati hai, magar yeh ghalat hai (Book correction): sirf cell wall hat'ti hai. Agar membrane bhi hat jaye to cell zinda hi nahi rahega.

blocks.prompt:
30 How is a gene transferred by chemical methods and by viruses?
(Chemical methods aur viruses se gene kaise muntaqil kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Chemical methods: naked DNA ko chemical agent se milaya jata hai aur complex diffusion ya endocytosis se cytoplasm mein jata hai.
Virus mediated: adenovirus, adeno-associated virus, HIV, lentivirus aur doosre retroviruses gene le jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: In chemical methods, the naked DNA is fused with a chemical agent.

blocks.prompt:
31 Name any four pharmaceutical products of transgenic bacteria with their uses.
(Transgenic bacteria ke koi chaar pharmaceutical products un ke istemal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Insulin: diabetes ka ilaj.
2. Human growth hormone: dwarfism (bonapan) ka ilaj.
3. Interferon: kuch cancers ka ilaj.
4. Tissue plasminogen activator: khoon ke lothre ghulata hai.

book_ref.quote: Genes from a wide range of organisms can be added to a plasmid and inserted into bacteria.

blocks.prompt:
32 Name three food products made by transgenic bacteria and state the use of each.
(Transgenic bacteria ke teen food products ke naam aur har aik ka istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Alpha-amylase: starch ko saada sugars mein badalta hai.
2. Chymosin: cheese ke liye doodh ka protein jamata hai.
3. Pectin-esterase: phalon ke juice ko saaf karta hai.

book_ref.quote: alpha-amylase (converts starch to simple sugars)

blocks.prompt:
33 How are transgenic bacteria used to protect the environment?
(Transgenic bacteria mahol ki hifazat ke liye kaise istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh aise enzymes banate hain jo toxins tor kar pollutants ko kam zehreela banate hain. Yeh ore se copper nikaalte, mercury ki aaloodgi saaf karte aur peene ke paani mein arsenic dhoondte hain.

book_ref.quote: Produce enzymes which degrade toxins to convert pollutants into a less toxic form.

blocks.prompt:
34 What is a transgenic animal? Give two examples of transgenic goats.
(Transgenic animal kya hai? Transgenic bakriyon ki do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Transgenic animal mein ghair gene hota hai jo matloob protein banata hai (dawaon, zyada paidawar ya bimari se mazbooti ke liye). Transgenic bakriyan mazboot makri ke jale jaise silk proteins wala doodh, aur insani enzyme lysozyme wala doodh deti hain jo dast wale bacteria se larta hai.

book_ref.quote: A transgenic animal carries a foreign gene to produce the desired protein.

blocks.prompt:
35 What is the role of genetically modified viruses in gene therapy?
(Gene therapy mein genetically modified viruses ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene therapy mein genetically modified viruses insanon tak genes pahunchate hain taa ke wirasati bimariyan, jaise T aur B cells ki ghair-maamooli nashonuma aur wirasati andhapan, ka ilaj ho.

book_ref.quote: In gene therapy, genetically modified viruses are used to deliver genes to humans

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between germline and somatic cell gene insertion in humans.
(Insanon mein germline aur somatic cells mein gene daalne ka farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Germline tabdeeli wirasat mein jati hai; zyada tehqeeq somatic cells par hai.

book_ref.quote: In theory, foreign genes may be inserted either in germline or in somatic cells of humans.

rows: Wirasati tabdeeli aati hai
Tabdeeli germline ke zariye aage nahi jati
Khatraat aur akhlaqi masail hain
Zyada tar tehqeeq isi par hui hai

blocks.prompt:
37 What is totipotency? Why is it useful in making transgenic plants?
(Totipotency kya hai? Transgenic paude banane mein yeh kyun mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Totipotency ka matlab hai ke aik plant cell poora naya paudha bana sakta hai. Kyunke bohat se plant cells totipotent hain, biologists aik transgenic cell se poora naya paudha uga lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Biologists grow a new plant from a transgenic cell of plant.

blocks.prompt:
38 What are Bt plants? Name four crops into which these genes have been inserted.
(Bt plants kya hain? Chaar faslon ke naam likhein jin mein yeh genes dale gaye hain.)
blocks.explanation: Bt plants mein mitti ke bacterium Bacillus thuringiensis ke genes hote hain; yeh genes aise proteins banate hain jo nuqsandeh keeron ko maarte magar mufeed keeron ko nuqsan nahi dete. Faslein: cotton, rice, maize, potato (tomato, brinjal, cauliflower, cabbage bhi).

book_ref.quote: Genes of Bacillus thuringiensis (a soil bacterium) have been inserted in many plants

blocks.prompt:
39 How has transgenic rice been made richer in iron and vitamin A?
(Transgenic rice ko iron aur vitamin A mein kaise behtar banaya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Iron barhane wale genes beans, Aspergillus fungus aur wild rice se le kar rice mein dale gaye. Beta-carotene (vitamin A ka pehla madda) banane ke genes daffodil se le kar dale gaye. Yeh un ilaqon mein ugaya jata hai jahan khurak mein iron aur vitamin A kam hai.

book_ref.quote: These genes were taken from beans, Aspergillus fungus, and wild rice.

blocks.text: 20.5 Formation of human insulin in bacteria

blocks.prompt:
40 Why are two different DNA sequences synthesised in the production of human insulin?
(Human insulin ki tayyari mein do mukhtalif DNA sequences kyun banayi jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Insulin do alag polypeptide chains, A aur B, par mushtamil hai. Is liye aik DNA sequence chain A ke liye aur doosri chain B ke liye banti hai; chains alag alag ban kar phir kimiyai taur par jodi jati hain.

book_ref.quote: By using bacteria, scientists produce vast quantities of insulin

blocks.prompt:
41 Name the five steps of making human insulin in bacteria.
(Bacteria mein human insulin banane ke paanch qadamon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Do genes ki tayyari
2. Recombinant plasmids ki tameer
3. Host cells ki transformation (Escherichia coli ki do cultures)
4. Fermentation aur protein expression
5. Nikalna aur kimiyai taur par jodna

book_ref.quote: Culture 1 acts as a factory for Chain A. Culture 2 acts as a factory for Chain B.

blocks.prompt:
42 How are the insulin chains joined to form functional insulin?
(Insulin chains ko jod kar fa'al insulin kaise banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria jama kar ke chains nikaali aur saaf ki jati hain. Lab mein chain A aur chain B milayi jati hain aur makhsoos amino acids ke darmiyan disulfide bonds (sulfur-sulfur pul) se jurti hain, aur fa'al teen-jihati insulin molecule banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Once the chains are synthesized, the bacteria are harvested
